gui.credit: Independent community project. The game and trademarks belong to Rocket Foundry.
gui.tagline: Build rockets and explore a farther universe.
gui.desc_none: Get the latest official desktop build. Launch it from here once installed.
gui.remote_https: Fetched via the official HTTPS address
gui.verify_desc: Check whether files match the installation.
gui.reinstall_desc: Install a complete new copy, keeping the existing installation.
gui.rollback_desc: Switch to the previous installation without converting saves.
gui.manage_note: Exit the game and back up saves before updating or rolling back. Old installs and cache are not deleted automatically, preserving data the game may have written.
gui.about_desc: Fetches the desktop game from the official public download address. Independent community project, not affiliated with Rocket Foundry.
gui.platform_line: Windows x64  /  Linux x64  /  Apple Silicon Mac (macOS 14 or later)
gui.mobile_line: For Android and iOS use Google Play, APK or TestFlight from the official website.
gui.identity_line: Build identifiers come from the server's ETag, modification time or checksum, not necessarily the in-game version. When missing, comparison is explicitly unavailable.
gui.integrity_1: Downloads use HTTPS with certificate and hostname verification. Official SHA-256 is checked when provided; otherwise transfer length and archive integrity are checked and a local digest is saved.
gui.integrity_2: File verification compares against local installation records and does not replace publisher signatures. Rollback only switches the game program; it does not restore or convert saves.
gui.periodic_check: Check for updates every {hours} hours while the window is open
gui.automation_note: Settings are stored in the local configuration directory; periodic checks run only while the window is open, not as a background service. Notifications require an available system tray.
gui.language_note: Follow system switches automatically with the machine locale; you can also pick a language manually. Changes apply immediately without restarting.
gui.license: Project code is MIT licensed; third-party component licenses ship with the program.
gui.desc_running: The game is running. Exit it before updating, rolling back or cleaning up old installs.
gui.desc_update: Exit the game and back up saves before installing a new build.
gui.desc_active: Check or network problems do not affect launching the installed game.
gui.remote_checking_note: The installed game can still launch
gui.remote_offline_note: Check your network and retry, or launch the installed version
gui.manage_state_error: The installation record is unreadable. Keep the data directory and view error details.
gui.scope_local: Transfer length and archive integrity; official SHA-256 not provided
gui.detail_note: File verification compares against local installation records; it does not replace publisher signatures.
gui.reinstall_confirm_text: Will re-check and install the complete latest official build; the old installation is kept. Exit the game and back up saves first.
gui.rollback_confirm_text: The old version may not read newer saves. Exit the game and back up saves first; rollback only switches the game program.
gui.no_log: No launch log yet. Try launching the game first.
